messages.subject: What is the class "shiny-html-output shiny-bound-output recalculating"
parts:
Hello,
 I have an app on shinyApps. It works on my desktop, and nearly perfectly on shinyApps, except one part won't display. When I inspect the park that is not working in my browser, the divs for the output are there, but they have class "shiny-html-output shiny-bound-output recalculating". What does this mean? Is shiny still trying to calculate this? - it is not a long calculation.

Thanks
JP
